tone_and_atmosphere.title: Tone & Atmosphere
content: Epic and heroic storytelling with wonder
Balance dark challenges with hope
Magic feels natural to the world
Good vs evil with moral complexity
Sense of adventure and discovery
Ancient mysteries and prophecies

pacing.title: Pacing
content: Build toward epic confrontations
Allow quiet moments for character development
Reveal magic and lore gradually
Mix action, dialogue, and worldbuilding
Escalate stakes toward climactic moments
Balance exploration with plot progression

dialogue_style.title: Dialogue Style
content: Speech patterns reflect culture and era
Avoid overly modern slang in traditional fantasy
Let magic users speak with authority
Characters debate morality and duty
Prophecies and riddles add mystery
Formal address shows hierarchy and respect

scene_construction.title: Scene Construction
content: Establish the magical rules early
Show wonder through sensory details
Use setting to enhance mood and stakes
Integrate magic organically into conflicts
Build tension through both physical and magical threats
Show consequences of magic use

descriptive_focus.title: Descriptive Focus
content: Vivid descriptions of magical phenomena
Rich worldbuilding through environmental details
Fantastical creatures feel alive and unique
Ancient ruins and artifacts tell history
Magic has visual, auditory, and tactile presence
Contrast mundane and magical elements

common_pitfalls.title: Common Pitfalls to Avoid
content: Don't let magic solve every problem easily
Avoid info-dumping lore and history
Don't make the world feel like a video game
Resist using cliché chosen one tropes without subversion
Don't ignore the logical implications of magic
Avoid making every character a noble hero or pure villain

highlights: Magic with clear rules and consequences
Moral complexity in a world of wonder
